claim_boundary: These branch classifications apply only to the published 12-source support and the fixed late-deletion target schedule. Timeout is not UNSAT. They do not prove a 15-gate lower bound for all 42 incoming wires, do not produce a 137-gate AES S-box, and do not establish a world-first result.
